results.note: Notitia historica — searched extensively but found no English translation of this minor work. Appears in PL vol. 3 columns 675D-678A.

Vita Sancti Hilarii — listed in batch as PL vol. 9 columns 184C-184D, but vol. 9 typically contains Hilary of Poitiers' works, not Jerome's. Possible data error, fragment, or misattribution. Cannot confirm translation status without access to actual text.

Epistolae (Jerome's Letters) — fully translated in NPNF2-06 by W.H. Fremantle (1893), public domain. Also: C.C. Mierow trans. in ACW 33 (1963); recent FOC editions by Thomas Scheck (2023-2024) with previously untranslated letters.
Adversus Jovinianum — fully translated in NPNF2-06 by W.H. Fremantle, public domain. Two-book polemical work on virginity and celibacy.

Apologia adversus libros Rufini — fully translated in NPNF2-06 by W.H. Fremantle, public domain. Three-book defense against Rufinus' charges, listed as 'Against Rufinus, books i and ii (402), iii (404)' in NPNF prolegomena.
Commentarius in Ecclesiasten — translated by Richard J. Goodrich, Ancient Christian Writers Series vol. 66 (2012), copyrighted (Paulist Press).
Contra Joannem Hierosolymitanum — fully translated in NPNF2-06 as 'To Pammachius against John of Jerusalem' by W.H. Fremantle, public domain.
Contra Vigilantium — fully translated in NPNF2-06 by W.H. Fremantle, public domain. Polemic against Vigilantius' ascetical positions (406 CE).
De situ et nominibus locorum Hebraicorum — only the Preface is translated in NPNF2-06 (pp. 485-86) by W.H. Fremantle, public domain. Full commentary text not available in English translation.
De virginitate B. Mariae (Perpetual Virginity of Blessed Mary) — fully translated in NPNF2-06 by W.H. Fremantle, public domain.
De viris illustribus (On Illustrious Men) — fully translated in NPNF2-06 (and Schaff translation), public domain. Biographical compendium of 135 ecclesiastical writers.
Dialogus contra Luciferianos (Dialogue Against the Luciferians) — fully translated in NPNF2-06 by W.H. Fremantle, public domain.
Dialogus contra Pelagianos (Against the Pelagians) — fully translated in NPNF2-06 by W.H. Fremantle, public domain. Three-book dialogue with prologue against Pelagian doctrine.
Excerpta de aliquot Palestinae locis — no English translation located despite searching. Related to Jerome's work on Palestinian geography but distinct from De situ work.
Quaestiones Hebraicae in Genesim (Hebrew Questions on Genesis) — first English translation by C.T.R. Hayward (1995), copyrighted (Oxford Classical Monographs).
Vita Malchi monachi captivi (Life of Malchus, the Captive Monk) — fully translated in NPNF2-06 by W.H. Fremantle, public domain.
Vita S. Hilarionis (Life of Saint Hilarion) — fully translated in NPNF2-06 by W.H. Fremantle, public domain. Also in Early Christian Biographies (1952).
Vita S. Pauli primi eremitae (Life of Paul the First Hermit) — fully translated in NPNF2-06 by W.H. Fremantle, public domain.

Commentaria in Isaiam (Commentary on Isaiah) — translated by Thomas P. Scheck, Ancient Christian Writers Series vol. 68 (2015), copyrighted (Paulist Press). Scheck's is the major modern English translation.
Commentaria in Jeremiam (Commentary on Jeremiah) — translated by Michael Graves, InterVarsity Press Academic (2012), copyrighted.

Commentaria in Abacuc (Commentary on Habakkuk) — translated in IVP 'Ancient Christian Texts' series, Commentaries on the Twelve Prophets Volume 1, ed./trans. Thomas P. Scheck et al. (2016-2017), copyrighted.
Commentaria in Abdiam (Commentary on Obadiah) — translated in IVP Commentaries on the Twelve Prophets Volume 1, ed./trans. Thomas P. Scheck et al. (2016-2017), copyrighted.
Commentaria in Aggaeum (Commentary on Haggai) — translated in IVP Commentaries on the Twelve Prophets Volume 1, ed./trans. Thomas P. Scheck et al. (2016-2017), copyrighted.
Commentaria in Joelem (Commentary on Joel) — translated in IVP Commentaries on the Twelve Prophets Volume 2, ed./trans. Thomas P. Scheck et al. (2016-2017), copyrighted.
Commentaria in Malachiam (Commentary on Malachi) — translated in IVP Commentaries on the Twelve Prophets Volume 2, ed./trans. Thomas P. Scheck et al. (2016-2017), copyrighted.
Commentaria in Naum (Commentary on Nahum) — translated in IVP Commentaries on the Twelve Prophets Volume 1, ed./trans. Thomas P. Scheck et al. (2016-2017), copyrighted.
Commentaria in Sophoniam (Commentary on Zephaniah) — translated in IVP Commentaries on the Twelve Prophets Volume 1, ed./trans. Thomas P. Scheck et al. (2016-2017), copyrighted.
Commentaria in Zachariam (Commentary on Zechariah) — translated in IVP Commentaries on the Twelve Prophets Volume 2, ed./trans. Thomas P. Scheck et al. (2016-2017), copyrighted.
Commentaria in Epistolam ad Ephesios (Commentary on Ephesians) — translated by Rowan A. Greer (Heine's edition, 2002), copyrighted. Part of broader Pauline commentary tradition.
Commentaria in Epistolam ad Galatas (Commentary on Galatians) — translated by Thomas P. Scheck (2010) and Andrew Cain (2010), copyrighted modern editions from academic/religious publishers.
Commentaria in Epistolam ad Philemonem (Commentary on Philemon) — translated by Thomas P. Scheck (2010), copyrighted. Part of Pauline epistles series.
Commentaria in Epistolam ad Titum (Commentary on Titus) — translated by Thomas P. Scheck (2010), copyrighted. Part of Pauline epistles series.
Commentaria in Job — no complete English translation located. Only Jerome's Prologue to Job translated by Kevin P. Edgecomb (2006, public domain). Full commentary remains untranslated.
Commentaria in Matthaeum (Commentary on Matthew) — translated by Thomas P. Scheck, Fathers of the Church series vol. 117 (2008), copyrighted (Catholic University of America Press).

Chronicon S. Hieronymi (Jerome's Chronicle) — complete English translation by Roger Pearse et al., collaborative project completed 2005, public domain and freely available online at tertullian.org. Also: Donalson's 1996 partial translation (326-378 AD).

Canticum Canticorum (Song of Songs — Jerome's Vulgate text) — available in English via Douay-Rheims translation of the Vulgate (public domain, freely available at vulgate.org and BibleStudyTools). Represents Jerome's Latin biblical text.

Liber Danielis (Book of Daniel — Jerome's Vulgate text) — available in English via Douay-Rheims translation of the Vulgate (public domain). Also: Gleason L. Archer's 1958 translation of Jerome's commentary on Daniel available.
Liber Deuteronomii (Book of Deuteronomy — Jerome's Vulgate text) — available in English via Douay-Rheims translation of the Vulgate (public domain, freely available at vulgate.org).

Liber Ecclesiastes (Book of Ecclesiastes — Jerome's Vulgate text) — available in English via Douay-Rheims translation of the Vulgate (public domain). Note: separate from Commentary on Ecclesiastes (work 595).
Liber Esther (Book of Esther — Jerome's Vulgate text) — available in English via Douay-Rheims translation of the Vulgate (public domain, freely available at vulgate.org).
Liber Exodi (Book of Exodus — Jerome's Vulgate text) — available in English via Douay-Rheims translation of the Vulgate (public domain, freely available at vulgate.org).

Liber Ezechielis (Book of Ezekiel — Jerome's Vulgate text OR Commentary on Ezekiel) — translated by Thomas P. Scheck, Ancient Christian Writers series vol. 71, copyrighted (Paulist Press). Scheck's translation of the full commentary is the major modern English version.
Liber Ezrae (Book of Ezra — Jerome's Vulgate text) — available in English via Douay-Rheims translation of the Vulgate (public domain, freely available at vulgate.org).
Liber Genesis (Book of Genesis — Jerome's Vulgate text) — available in English via Douay-Rheims translation of the Vulgate (public domain, freely available at vulgate.org).
Liber Isaiae (Book of Isaiah — Jerome's Vulgate text) — available in English via Douay-Rheims translation of the Vulgate (public domain). Note: separate from Commentary on Isaiah (work 614).
